Extract raw poly(A)/poly(T) tail signals with flanks from POD5 files (cDNA)

Source: R/ninetails_core_functions_cDNA_model.R
extract_tail_signals_cdna.Rd

Extracts the raw signal of each tail together with 100 samples on each side (clipped at the read ends). In contrast to extract_tails_from_pod5, the signal is neither winsorized nor downsampled, because the cDNA models work on the raw 5 kHz signal.

Usage

extract_tail_signals_cdna(tail_coordinates, pod5_dir, num_cores = 1)

Arguments

tail_coordinates

Data frame. Output of read_tail_coordinates_cdna.

pod5_dir

Character string. Path to the directory with POD5 files.

num_cores

Numeric [1]. Number of physical cores to use.

Value

A named list of numeric vectors (raw signal), one per read with valid coordinates, named with read IDs. The tail starts at sample min(tail_start, 100) (0-based) of each vector.

Details

If the filename column is not available (Lachesis output), every POD5 file in pod5_dir is scanned for the requested reads.

See also

read_tail_coordinates_cdna, predict_nonA_cdna

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{

signal_list <- ninetails::extract_tail_signals_cdna(
  tail_coordinates = coordinates,
  pod5_dir = '/path/to/pod5/',
  num_cores = 2)

} # }
